summary: Sorsogon 2nd District representative with 85 principal-authored bills. Authored DSWD crisis assistance, a Walang Gutom food stamp program, solo-parent financial assistance, compassionate paid leave, youth mental health programs and an autism care plan. Also authored party-list reform and a deepfake personality-rights bill; co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Party-list reform, privacy and policing items are single issues and unscored. Bill-based evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored food stamp program and DSWD crisis aid (-3), solo-parent aid (-2), health and mental health programs (-2) and five days paid compassionate leave (-2); co-authored minimum wage (-2).
